title: Giraffe holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M38 22 C38 32, 42 40, 45 48' stroke='#f4f4f4' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='14' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='10' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#ff8fa3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <polygon points='36,26 40,26 38,29' fill='#e63955'/>
  <!-- Giraffe body -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='72' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <!-- Body spots -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='68' r='3.5' fill='#d4842a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='66' r='3' fill='#d4842a'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='72' r='3.5' fill='#d4842a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='78' r='3' fill='#d4842a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='79' r='2.5' fill='#d4842a'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='48' y='82' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <rect x='60' y='83' width='6' height='13' rx='3' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <rect x='70' y='82' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <rect x='78' y='83' width='6' height='13' rx='3' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='48' y='93' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='60' y='93' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='70' y='93' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='78' y='93' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d='M42 70 C40 58, 38 50, 36 42 L48 40 C50 50, 52 58, 54 68 Z' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <!-- Neck spots -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#d4842a'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#d4842a'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='47' r='2' fill='#d4842a'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='36' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f4b942'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='38' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#f8d48a'/>
  <!-- Nostril -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#3d2b1f'/>
  <circle cx='38.8' cy='32.2' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Ossicones (horns) -->
  <line x1='35' y1='28' x2='33' y2='22' stroke='#f4b942' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='22' r='2.5' fill='#d4842a'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='28' x2='44' y2='22' stroke='#f4b942' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='22' r='2.5' fill='#d4842a'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='30' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#f4b942' transform='rotate(-20 28 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='30' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#f4b942' transform='rotate(20 48 30)'/>
  <!-- Front arm holding string -->
  <path d='M46 68 C44 60, 42 54, 44 48' stroke='#f4b942' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Hoof on arm -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='47' r='3' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M84 70 C88 68, 90 72, 89 76' stroke='#f4b942' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='89' cy='77' r='2' fill='#d4842a'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M31 41 Q34 44 37 41' stroke='#8b5a2b' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
